blurb: Guests can enjoy narrated boat cruises around Biscayne Bay, including family-friendly tours, party cruises, and special event cruises like holiday fireworks. There is also a tarpon feeding experience on a floating dock at Bayside Marketplace. Cruises vary in duration and include options with drinks and DJs for adults only.
extraNote: Tickets fully refundable up to 24 hours before trip if purchased on website; otherwise all sales final · Missed boats can be rescheduled once free; additional reschedules cost $5 per person · Trips run rain or shine; only hazardous marine conditions cause cancellations · Rescheduling allowed to cruises of equal or lesser value except some exceptions · Bayside Marketplace / Miamarina, Slips 11 & 12; ticket booth near docks between Tasca Paella and Casa Italia with a large red umbrella
